name: get_host_shell
description: Inspect the shell executable, default working directory, and capabilities on Ivenna's host. Available capabilities can be used now; planned capabilities are not implemented yet. Use run_host_shell to execute commands.

name: run_host_shell
description: Execute a command through /bin/sh on Ivenna's host as the service account, and wait for completion or timeout. Commands inherit the service process environment with batch-output overrides. Each call has a separate shell with no terminal or live stdin; use pipes or heredocs for input. Remaining processes in its process group are stopped when the call ends. Replies contain {result: {outcome, stdout, stderr}} or {error: {code, message}}. Outcome is {completed: {exited: code}} or another termination variant, such as {completed: {signal: 'TERM'}}, or {timed_out: {}}. Each stream contains {text, truncated, path}: a preview limited to 16 KiB, whether content was omitted, and the full log's absolute path. The log can be read for omitted output. Timeouts retain captured output; interruption does not undo host changes.

command.description: The shell command to execute. Supports pipelines, redirection, and multiple commands.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to the service startup directory. Omit to use the service startup directory.

timeout_ms.description: Total execution time in milliseconds. Omit for 600000 (10 minutes).

name: browse_memory_room
description: Explore a memory room and discover its child rooms and memory entries. Rooms persist across sessions; choose their organization freely. All memory tools reply with either {result: ...} or {error: {code, message}}. Here, result contains room and entries; each entry has address, name, and kind (room or memory).

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

name: find_memory
description: Find memory entries and rooms by name within a room and its descendants. Use recall_memory to search remembered content. The result contains room, query, and matches; each match has address, name, and kind. No matches returns an empty matches list.

query.description: The name or name pattern to find. Literal mode matches part of a name.

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

match_mode.description: Interpret query as literal text (default), a glob such as "*.md", or a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

name: recall_memory
description: Search memory entries for a clue within a room and its descendants. The result contains room, clue, and matches; each match has address, line, and text. Use a matching address to read the full entry. No matches returns an empty matches list.

clue.description: The text or pattern to find in memory entries.

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

match_mode.description: Interpret clue as literal text (default) or a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

name: read_memory
description: Read a memory entry at a known location. Browse or search first if you need to find it. The result contains address and content.

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

name: remember
description: Write supplied content to a memory entry. The containing room must already exist. The result contains address.

address.description: The location for the memory entry, relative to the shared entrance.

content.description: The content to keep in this entry.

mode.description: create makes a new entry and reports an occupied location; append adds content without inserting a separator; replace writes the full content. append and replace also create a missing entry. Default: create.

name: revise_memory
description: Revise matching text in an existing memory entry. The result contains address and revision (no_match, unchanged, or revised).

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

old_text.description: The text to match, or a regular expression when match_mode is regex.

new_text.description: The replacement text. Regex mode expands captures such as ${1} and ${name}; literal mode keeps this text as supplied.

replace_all.description: Replace every match. Omit to replace only the first.

match_mode.description: Interpret old_text as literal text (default) or a regular expression. Literal matching is case-sensitive; a regex can set inline flags.

name: create_memory_room
description: Create a room to organize memory entries and child rooms. Parent rooms are created as needed, and an existing room can be reused. Choose names and organization freely. The result contains address.

address.description: The new room location, relative to the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Move or rename a memory entry or a room and its contents. The destination may be a new location or an existing room to move into. An occupied target is reported as an error. The result contains the actual new address. References in memory content are not rewritten automatically.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

destination.description: The new location, or an existing room to move into. Both are relative to the shared entrance.

name: forget_memory
description: Remove a memory entry or an empty room. Set recursive to true to remove a room and all its contents. The shared entrance is retained. The result contains address.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

recursive.description: Remove all entries and child rooms at this location. Omit to remove only an entry or an empty room.

name: wait_for_input
description: Request a pause when this tool batch finishes and no input is queued. New input or an explicit resume continues the same session and history.
